label: Bible Study
prompt: Train up a _____ in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
note: The parenting verse taped to a million refrigerators.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your _____.
verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
note: The finding is guaranteed; the fine print is 'with all your heart.' Half-hearted need not apply.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Enter into his gates with _____, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
note: The gate password is thanksgiving; praise gets you into the courts.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They that sow in _____ shall reap in joy.
verse: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
note: The exiles' harvest law: what you plant weeping, you carry home singing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness _____ it not.
verse: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
note: Where modern versions say 'overcome,' the KJV says the darkness 'comprehended it not.'
